question.html:
A ring of mass M = 0.32 kg and radius R = 0.25 m is accelerated from rest by a constant torque of 0.20 N m. The moment of inertia of the ring is MR2.

a Calculate:

a.i the angular acceleration of the ring; [2]

a.ii the angular velocity of the ring after a time of 5.0 s. [1]

b A solid disc of the same mass and radius as the ring is accelerated by the same torque. Compare, without calculation:

b.i the angular impulse delivered to the disc and to the ring during the first 5.0 s. [2]

b.ii the final kinetic energy of the disc and the ring. [2]
